verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a self-serve API-key signup flow for Llama; instead, evidence shows the opposite — llama.com's own developer docs are gated behind an SSO identity wall (llama-supp-docs-gated) and model weight access requires submitting a request and waiting for a signed email approval (llama-gh-5), i.e. an approval/waitlist-like gymnastics rather than instant self-serve minting. No openapi/llms.txt or signup docs were found either (llama-probe-1, llama-probe-2).
